**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The EXCLUSIVITY rule is satisfied at the preferred position. The agreement contains no exclusivity, "sole provider," or requirements-purchase obligation binding us as Licensee; the license is repeatedly characterised as non-exclusive, and the only "first refusal" right is a change-of-control right that does not touch our sourcing freedom.

One note for the wider review (outside this rule): Article XXII's Right of First Refusal (p0139) and the Article XX Change of Control auto-termination (p0134) do impose meaningful restrictions on our corporate flexibility, and should be picked up under the assignment/change-of-control rules.
